dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城邸に遊びに来ていた。
dialogues.en: I went to Tsukishiro's house to visit.
dialogues.text: I went to Tsukishiro's house to visit.

dialogues.jp:
どことなく、前にも増して柔らかい笑みを浮か
べる瀬場さん。
dialogues.en:
In front of me, was the smiling Seiba-san, his usual smile
seeming even more bright today.
dialogues.text:
In front of me, was the smiling Seiba-san, his usual smile
seeming even more bright today.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その隣には、にっこりと笑っている月
城がいた。
dialogues.en:
And beside him, Tsukishiro had a similar, wide smile on
hers.
dialogues.text:
And beside him, Tsukishiro had a similar, wide smile on
hers.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様のおかげで、お嬢様はこんなに元気に
　なられました……」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress has become so cheerful, all thanks to
Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress has become so cheerful, all thanks to
Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「俺だけじゃあないです。美春や、眞子や、え
　えと、杉並の力があったからですよ」
dialogues.en:
"It wasn't just me.. Miharu, and Mako.... and, er, Suginami,
all helped too."
dialogues.text:
"It wasn't just me.. Miharu, and Mako.... and, er, Suginami,
all helped too."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……先輩達のおかげで、私はもうお話しする
　のが怖くなくなりました」
dialogues.en:
"...Thanks to everyone, I'm not scared of speaking my mind
anymore."
dialogues.text:
"...Thanks to everyone, I'm not scared of speaking my mind
anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ピロスがいなくても、もうお話ができるの」
dialogues.en:
"Piros may not be around anymore, but... I can still talk
now."
dialogues.text:
"Piros may not be around anymore, but... I can still talk
now."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ピロスは、残念だったね」
dialogues.en: "...What happened to Piros was just bad luck."
dialogues.text: "...What happened to Piros was just bad luck."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……はい。私のたったひとりの友達でしたか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "...Yes. He used to by my only friend, after all."
dialogues.text: "...Yes. He used to by my only friend, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様は、とても大切にされていましたから
　ね……。心中お察し致します」
dialogues.en:
"It was quite important to you, indeed... a Romeo and Juliet
situation would not have been a horrible comparision."
dialogues.text:
"It was quite important to you, indeed... a Romeo and Juliet
situation would not have been a horrible comparision."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「でも、今は朝倉先輩がいるから……」
dialogues.en: "But now, I have Asakura-senpai..."
dialogues.text: "But now, I have Asakura-senpai..."

dialogues.jp: 月城がそう言って、ちらりと俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro glanced at me shyly, as she spoke.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro glanced at me shyly, as she spoke.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、そう言われると照れくさいな」
dialogues.en: "That's kinda embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "That's kinda embarassing..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「瀬場さん、私、皆さんにお礼がしたいです。
　何かできることはないかな」
dialogues.en:
"Seiba-san, I wish to show my appreciation to everyone for
what they have done... do you have any ideas on how I can do
so?"
dialogues.text:
"Seiba-san, I wish to show my appreciation to everyone for
what they have done... do you have any ideas on how I can do
so?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「お礼、ですか……」
dialogues.en: "Show your appreciation, you say..."
dialogues.text: "Show your appreciation, you say..."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが、ヒゲを撫でながら、ふうむと｛うな／唸｝る。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san hummed to himself, rubbing his considerable
moustache.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san hummed to himself, rubbing his considerable
moustache.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お世話になった方達をお招きして、お茶会を
　開くというのはいかがでしょうか？」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps an invitation to a tea party, for the friends that
have looked after you so much, would be in order?"
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps an invitation to a tea party, for the friends that
have looked after you so much, would be in order?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……お茶会」
dialogues.en: "...A tea party..."
dialogues.text: "...A tea party..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「おいしいお茶やお菓子を用意致します。皆さ
　んで楽しい一時を過ごされてはいかがでしょ
　う？　どうでしょう、朝倉様」
dialogues.en:
"I would prepare the snacks. I believe it would be an
enjoyable party for everyone. What do you think,
Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text:
"I would prepare the snacks. I believe it would be an
enjoyable party for everyone. What do you think,
Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いいんじゃないですか？　きっと楽しいと思
　います」
dialogues.en: "It sounds good to me. I'm sure it'd be fun."
dialogues.text: "It sounds good to me. I'm sure it'd be fun."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、そうしましょう。瀬場さん、よろし
　くお願い致します」
dialogues.en:
"Then, so it shall be. Seiba-san, please begin the
preparations."
dialogues.text:
"Then, so it shall be. Seiba-san, please begin the
preparations."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「かしこまりました。この瀬場、腕によりをか
　けて、おいしいものをご用意致します」
dialogues.en:
"At once. This undeserving Seiba, will make even more
delicious snacks than I ever have."
dialogues.text:
"At once. This undeserving Seiba, will make even more
delicious snacks than I ever have."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「……あの、いつも出てくるお菓子や料理って、
　瀬場さんが作っていたんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"...Um, all the time you served the sweets and food... you
made them all, Seiba-san?"
dialogues.text:
"...Um, all the time you served the sweets and food... you
made them all, Seiba-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい、そうでございますが、なにか？　私こ
　れでも料理が趣味でして……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, that is true. Is there something wrong? The culinary
arts are quite interesting to me..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, that is true. Is there something wrong? The culinary
arts are quite interesting to me..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「思い出します。あの雪山での潜入捜査……。
　手持ちの食料は、すっかり底を尽きまして、
　辺りにあるものを……」
dialogues.en:
"It brings back memories of that freezing mountain, that
espionage operation... all the rations I had on hand,
consumed..."
dialogues.text:
"It brings back memories of that freezing mountain, that
espionage operation... all the rations I had on hand,
consumed..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「瀬場さん、それ、料理とはちょっと違うんじゃ
　……」
dialogues.en:
"Seiba-san, I wouldn't exactly call that as participating in
the culinary arts..."
dialogues.text:
"Seiba-san, I wouldn't exactly call that as participating in
the culinary arts..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっはっは、そうですか。これは失礼い
　たしました」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha ha ha, I suppose so. Please excuse my rambling."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha ha ha, I suppose so. Please excuse my rambling."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……お茶会は、春休みの終わりの日がいいで
　すよね」
dialogues.en:
"...The last day of spring break sounds like a good day for
a tea party."
dialogues.text:
"...The last day of spring break sounds like a good day for
a tea party."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。それまでに、一緒に招待状を書こ
　うぜ」
dialogues.en: "That, it does. Let's make the invitation cards together."
dialogues.text: "That, it does. Let's make the invitation cards together."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様、私めがここにいるというのに、なか
　なか大胆でございますな」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sama, perhaps I should do some shopping, and leave
the two of you alone?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sama, perhaps I should do some shopping, and leave
the two of you alone?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「え？　あ、あの……その、やだな。そんなつ
　もりじゃないんだって」
dialogues.en: "Eh? U, um... n, no, it's not what you're thinking..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? U, um... n, no, it's not what you're thinking..."

dialogues.jp:
じゃあ、どんなつもりだと返されそうだけれど、
それは言わない約束ということで……。
dialogues.en:
Whatever he was thinking, I'm going to have to have him keep
it from Tsukishiro...
dialogues.text:
Whatever he was thinking, I'm going to have to have him keep
it from Tsukishiro...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩、楽しみですね」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai, it'd be lots of fun."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai, it'd be lots of fun."

dialogues.jp:
そんな月城の笑顔を見ると、そんなつもりがな
くても、つい……こうニヤけてしまうんだな、
これが。
dialogues.en:
Looking at Alice smile like that, I felt like I couldn't
ever corrupt that pure innoncence.
dialogues.text:
Looking at Alice smile like that, I felt like I couldn't
ever corrupt that pure innoncence.

dialogues.jp: ◆お茶会への招待状◆
dialogues.en: ◆Invitation to a Tea Party◆
dialogues.text: ◆Invitation to a Tea Party◆

dialogues.jp: 笑顔を取り戻した月城。
dialogues.en: The smile had finall returned on Tsukishiro's face.
dialogues.text: The smile had finall returned on Tsukishiro's face.

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんの提案で、美春や杉並を招いて、お茶
会を開いたら、ということになった。
dialogues.en:
At Seiba-san's suggestion, Miharu and Suginami were to be
invited to a tea party with us.
dialogues.text:
At Seiba-san's suggestion, Miharu and Suginami were to be
invited to a tea party with us.

dialogues.jp: そうだ。それがいい。
dialogues.en: That sounds really nice.
dialogues.text: That sounds really nice.

dialogues.jp:
俺と月城は、一緒に招待状を書こう、と笑い合
うのだった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro and I ended up making the invitations cards
together, our smiles matching perfectly.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro and I ended up making the invitations cards
together, our smiles matching perfectly.
